disclosures.title: not the Prime
disclosures.body: Dual Keres Prime is a separate item with its own Mastery and its own relic farm; this plan is only for the base weapon.

groups.mode: Steel Path with boosters for a fast run

rows.label: Tellurium
rows.note: drops from Archwing-mode Grineer in the water rooms
rows.alt: or Corpus Railjack survival in Veil Proxima (Salacia, Neptune Archwing also named)

conditions: Tellurium no longer drops from the Perita Rebellion's Hunhullus mission; that source was hotfixed out.
Drops that land in the water aren't always picked up by your pet; jump in periodically.
bonuses: Steel Path with a Drop Chance booster, Resource booster and Smeeta or Resourceful Retriever turns roughly 2 in 40 minutes with no boosters into 10-26 in 20 minutes.
Daily login rewards give Tellurium often enough that long-time players say they never farm it directly.
A loot frame (Nekros with Desecrate, or Khora/Hydroid) helps, but avoid Heat or Corrosive kills, which block Desecrate's extra roll.

conditions: Argon Crystals decay daily once picked up; farm them last, right before starting the build.

rows.label: Oxium
rows.note: Oxium Ospreys, any Corpus mission; kill it before it self-destructs or it drops nothing

bonuses: Do a single boosted Steel Path Ophelia run for the Tellurium, grab Argon last, then craft and level to 30.
